items.q: So, I was, I would say Ben Webster was one I really liked besides Coleman Hawkins.

ctx.x: And, another thing I [Recording interruption] wanted to (inaudible) Coleman Hawkins or those that weren't exactly trumpet players.

I was getting ready to bring up Coleman Hawkins. Ben Webster. So, I was, I would say Ben Webster was one I really liked besides Coleman Hawkins. Coleman Hawkins used to do different concerts with the small group in Long Island. He was, I don't know. I forgot how they advertised. It said the "Hawks" or something like that.
